title: Titanium Femoral Condyle
alloyReason: Ti-6Al-7Nb (ASTM F1295) is selected as Ni-free alternative for this orthopedic joints implant, replacing V with Nb to eliminate cytotoxicity while maintaining 900 MPa tensile equivalent to Ti-6Al-4V. This rationale is driven by total knee femoral condyle component (ti-6al-7nb) and service environment demands.
process: CNC swiss turning for orthopedic joints geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for total knee femoral application
commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for total knee femoral performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Femoral Condyle suitable for Total knee femoral condyle component (Ti-6Al-7Nb)?
faq.a: Titanium Femoral Condyle uses Ti-6Al-7Nb because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address orthopedic joints operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Femoral Condyle?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Femoral Condyle is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for total knee femoral requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Femoral Condyle require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. total knee femoral components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for total knee femoral application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Femoral Condyle shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Femoral Condyle includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet total knee femoral specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Knee implant / Femoral component orthopedic joints components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
